summary: verifica and fascicolo --file must stay declared as an MCP read path.
reason: The shared MCP guard leaves the ambiguous flag name file unblocked. Without mcp:read-flags, a caller can open any file the server account can read and receive excerpts back.
validated_outcome: TestFileFlagIsMCPReadPath: InputFlagBlocked is true for --file on verifica and fascicolo, and false for --al.
